info.title: AI Interview Platform API
info.description:
API for AI-powered interview platform. Base URL: `/api/v1`.

Authentication: Bearer JWT (access_token). Refresh token via HttpOnly Cookie.

Standard response envelope:
- Success: `{ success: true, data, meta, request_id }`
- Error: `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details }, request_id }`

post.description: Creates a recruiter account. Returns access_token and sets refresh_token as HttpOnly Cookie.
Reads refresh_token from HttpOnly Cookie. Returns new access_token and rotates refresh_token via Set-Cookie.

job_context.description: Optional job description for match scoring
